'''Khivan''' were a pair of [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|Stormtrooper transports]] that were part of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Operation Grain Snatch]]. Their part was to replace [[Overlord (Imperial)|Overlord]] [[Ghorin]] [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|shuttles']] officers with theirs who would claim that the Rebels were driven off. This was part of the plan to steal Ghorin's supply of [[Grain/Legends|grain]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] and replace it with poisoned grain.
